description: Fork of exp278 (dual-stream, E=64, d_v=24, ffn_lut+skip, soft residual_lut -> 1.7284 @ 8K). Two coupled changes: (1) d_v 24 -> 64 (=E, full per-head capacity); (2) out_proj from single TinyMHLut(input_dim=384) to ModuleList of H=6 per-head TinyMHLut(input_dim=64, n_outputs=E=64, tph=out_tph//H=341). Per-head outputs are summed. Each per-head LUT samples anchor pairs only within its head's d_v=64 slice -> structural prior matching standard transformer out_proj (per-head linear -> sum). H separate kernel launches at d_v=64 may be slow; test as MVP before committing to a library-level table-partitioning feature.
